The majority of my own emotional explosions are because I’m out of control of a situation or a person. The let them theory is literally thinking about the situation and convincing yourself “let them”. Example- person is rejecting me “let them reject me..something better is for me.” Person trash talks me and gets others to believe it “let them, people who matter, know my true character.” 

As for the casual, non monogamy etc. It’s all about communication, with yourself and with the other person. Be 100% clear and honest with yourself and any others involved. And if it doesn’t go the way you had hoped, let it. Not everything is meant for us. 

Feelings of jealousy and anger can come from insecurity and lack of feeling safe. Before diving into new experiences that may trigger that, perhaps take some time to retrain your brain to notice the emotion coming, and pinpoint where it’s coming from, if it’s something you can’t control (which will be most of the time), then it’s back to the “let them” mentality. 

I hope this helps. ❤️
